verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap's own docs say applications can receive job completion updates through webhooks, and the Jobs API changelog adds a webhook callback for canceled jobs, so registrable outbound HTTP callbacks exist for job events. The evidence is only two brief mentions, so the depth of the feature is undocumented here. Missing for 10: details on how a callback URL is registered, payload schema, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, coverage of any events beyond completion and cancellation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
